short_description: Evolutionary ecology research for continuous environment-driven adaptation, developmental morphology, lifecycle and derived plant representation.
purpose: Prove that plant adaptation, strategy diversity, developmental morphology and lifecycle emerge from environmental fields, resource trade-offs and inheritance, while visual fidelity remains derived representation without hardcoded biome/species/plant-type placement classes.
expected_outcome: Deterministic ecology evidence through seed lifecycle plus an extensible GrowthGraph -> PlantRenderDescription -> RendererProfile -> 3D/LOD representation pipeline.
